comment_regular: TESActorBase_ModAViBase reads current base AV via vtbl +0x128, adds the signed delta, then calls vtbl +0x134 SetAViBase. AVU clamps the delta so player skill/attribute bases cannot underflow below 0 or overflow past the safe cap.
